answer_1.quote: This study proposes a method for selecting knowledge based on both its relevance to the dialogue and its interestingness, allowing us the generation of responses that facilitate coherence and interest.

answer_2.quote: We use the accuracy (ACC) score... Additionally, we employ perplexity (PPL) of the ground-truth responses, unigram F1 (F1), BLEU-4, ROUGE-2, and distinct score (Dist-2). Moreover, we adopt G-Eval and MEEP, which are referencefree metrics using LLM.

answer_3.quote: G-Eval was used to evaluate the fluency (Flu.), coherence (Coh.), informativeness (Inf.), and interestingness (Int.) of the responses on a five-point Likert scale. The LLM used was GPT-4o.

answer_4.quote: A/B tests of the proposed method were conducted, comparing it with the base model... The crowdsourcing site Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) was used to evaluate the responses, with three annotators for each response.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated responses on fluency, coherence, informativeness, and interestingness using a five-point Likert scale.
